title: Prince Harry speaks about social media – level 2
paragraphs: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle visited the European Parliament in Brussels to support new rules for protecting children online.

Prince Harry spoke to EU politicians and warned that social media companies are hurting young people through addictive apps and online bullying. He pointed out that many people in the audience were checking their phones while he was speaking.

Harry supported the new EU Kids Act, which wants social media companies to take responsibility for keeping kids safe online. Meghan joined Harry to view a memorial for young people who died because of online harm. She didn’t give a speech though. European leaders thanked them and promised to continue making internet rules safer for children.
